chars.DAD: a stocky man in a mustard-yellow short-sleeve work shirt with a chest pocket, dark brown trousers and a black moustache
chars.SON: a skinny 13-year-old boy in a bright red tracksuit jacket with white side stripes and black trousers
chars.SISTER: a 10-year-old girl in a teal hoodie and a grey skirt with a teal hair bow
chars.GUEST: a middle-aged neighbour in a light grey djellaba and a white skullcap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan living room in Sidi Kacem with low banquette sofas, DAD sits next to GUEST drinking mint tea and points mockingly at SON standing by the door, DAD laughing with contempt, SON embarrassed with lowered head. Main characters in the centre of the frame. No text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SON and SISTER stand side by side against a plain painted wall in the modest living room, heads lowered, ashamed and sad, hands behind their backs. Centre of frame. No text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Evening at the front door of a small Moroccan house: DAD comes home from work carrying a lunch bag, SON bends to kiss DAD's hand while SISTER waits her turn nervously, DAD looks stern and satisfied. No text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: DAD frowns angrily with hands on hips in the hallway, SON and SISTER huddle together looking scared, wide-eyed. No weapons, no hitting. Centre of frame. No text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: DAD spreads his arms wide proudly in a small, plain, slightly crooked living room, showing it off to SON like it is a palace, SON looks unimpressed. Comic tone. Centre of frame. No text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At a low round dinner table with a tagine, DAD lectures with a raised finger pointing at the walls of the house while SON and SISTER roll their eyes, bored, chins in hands. Comic tone. No text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: DAD counts on his fingers listing favours to SON in the living room, with a strict accountant look, SON shrugs helplessly. Comic tone. Centre of frame. No text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SON sits on a banquette sofa looking up thoughtfully with a slight smile, holding a phone in his lap, cosy modest Moroccan room. Centre of frame. No text anywhere in the image.
